probes.label: Top-speed pull (WOT in top gear, 5 s)
Tires warm (> 150 F) most of the run

advice.text: Both axles lock under hard braking: brake pressure too high overall — bring it down to the knee.
advice.evidence: median deficit F 0.84 / R 0.59; 25/26 stops locked both

advice.text: Fronts saturate under braking before turn-in: brake pressure DOWN toward the knee, then balance 2-3% rearward.
advice.evidence: 27/53 corners red on the fronts in phase 1

advice.text: Launch wheelspin on the rears: accel diff lock down / taller 1st, or squeeze the throttle.
advice.evidence: median peak rear slip 8.13; 12/12 launches spun

advice.text: AWD fronts spinning at launch: center split more rearward / front accel diff down.
Mid-corner understeer: front ARB -2 clicks or front springs softer (mech balance up); if only in fast corners, aero balance forward instead.
advice.evidence: USI median +0.261 over 53 corners (32 understeer, 3 mid-corner front reds)

advice.text: Suspension hits full compression at speed: ride height up a notch or springs stiffer (verify on the HUD Suspension page).
advice.evidence: 69 bottoming frames above 40 mph (detector still coarse)

advice.text: Balance varies corner to corner (USI spread 0.42) — likely speed-dependent (mechanical vs aero). Split the verdict by corner speed before tuning.
